test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 15 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Nine friends K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S are sitting in a row and are facing South. L is sitting to the immediate right of M. M at the second place to the right of N. K is sitting at one end of the row. Only Q is seated between P and O. O is sitting at the third place to the left of K. S is sitting to the immediate left of N. There are only five people sitting to the right of M. Who is sitting to the immediate left of M?
solution:
**Friends**: K, L, M, N, O, P, Q, R and S (South facing)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Because the friends are facing South, when we say that L is to the left of M, it will be placed at the right in the diagram.

1) K is sitting at one end of the row. 

Case 1:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c765d39ebcd4b335c0b39d7c61a481b36e22b178b2cffc915142572c8f5fe75.png] 

Case 2:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3505e7ba7a696c95d000575e6d77160f94a51afc061130faf7a7059dc986842.png] 

2) O is sitting at the third place to the left of K. (So case 1 is eliminated)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3738b55ae5c7277d3fef7ba81bd7b178abca53a5448a63c4249030dea2cb5980.png] 

3) There are only five people sitting to the right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/20873bfe2f7c86fda91f44fb1795e41256f1788b9ad6c74811e9c3b97377ed00.png] 

4) L is sitting to the immediate right of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ee668114ffddb51cafc7c0659ad5949dd1b3a8b37d815af1294e3fc6dd500d2.png] 

5) M at the second place to the right of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5572804860ccd536275cd00fc81f80deec1a0c532bf0ec686c2c8758e5800414.png] 

6) Only Q is seated between P and O. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f8d5f094bd630081eda8c2e7f6564826ad30cf2e5f4581c31cdff4686c72def1.png] 

7) S is sitting to the immediate left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a366f2404340f08c983ec0ed5e34635f357836328fbeaece7038927f6e827286.png] 

Hence,** R** is sitting to the immediate left of M.
